module origen_007925 (
    input [2:0] state,
    input [3:0] data_count,
    output reg full,
    output reg empty,
    output reg wr_ack,
    output reg wr_err,
    output reg rd_ack,
    output reg rd_err
);

    // State definitions
    localparam IDLE = 3'b000;
    localparam WRITE = 3'b001;
    localparam READ = 3'b010;
    localparam WR_ERROR = 3'b011;
    localparam RD_ERROR = 3'b100;

    // FIFO Status Logic
    always @(*) begin
        full = (data_count == 4'd8);
        empty = (data_count == 4'd0);
    end

    // FIFO Operation State Machine
    always @(*) begin
        // Default output values
        wr_ack = 1'b0;
        wr_err = 1'b0;
        rd_ack = 1'b0;
        rd_err = 1'b0;

        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                // All signals are deasserted by default
            end
            WRITE: begin
                wr_ack = 1'b1;
            end
            READ: begin
                rd_ack = 1'b1;
            end
            WR_ERROR: begin
                wr_err = 1'b1;
            end
            RD_ERROR: begin
                rd_err = 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                // Undefined state, all outputs remain deasserted
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
